moves.name: Down Special (Summon Arsene)
notes: HDR's Down Special without Arsene, and the only way to call him: the Rebellion Gauge no longer summons him on its own. Needs 40 meter, and spends 20 - 0.15x the gauge on the summon -- 14 at the 40 minimum, down to 5 at full. What is left afterwards is how long Arsene stays: his entry scales his own timer by the remaining gauge (fighters/jack/src/doyle/status.rs). Meter comes only from damage Joker deals (fighters/jack/src/opff.rs), not from damage he takes. Vanilla made him intangible for the whole summon (frames 2-60); HDR's motion patch removes that along with most of the wait.

moves.name: Down Special (Dismiss Arsene)
notes: HDR's Down Special with Arsene out, sending him away early. Unavailable below 1 meter, which is the gauge running dry and dismissing him anyway (`special_lw_uniq`, fighters/jack/src/status/mod.rs). Vanilla made him intangible for the whole animation (frames 2-70); HDR's motion patch removes that along with most of the wait.
